description:
Complete the design, construction, development, testing, implementation, and technology delivery for business needs throughout the enterprise. Experienced Software Engineer is responsible for technical aspects of the entire process of agile development for moderately complex projects. 
 
 Design, code/develop, test, and implement moderately complex systems
 
Design solutions to solve moderately complex business problems, considering operational and functional aspects of the solution, demonstrating an understanding of the business function
 
Research and permanently resolve system problems and incidents
 
Mentor Apprentice and Associate Software Engineers to allow for skill/knowledge development through advice, coaching, and training opportunities
 
 Job Specifications 
 
 Typically has the following skills or abilities: 
 
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent experience
 
4+ years of programming experience
 
Proficient programming experience in one or more current programming languages
 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 
Strong technical knowledge of all phases of application development, including analysis and programming
 
Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the performance of job duties

For roles that are remote (i.e., Work From Home (WFH)) or hybrid (i.e., partial onsite at a VSP location and WFH), must demonstrate a high level of engagement in virtual environments, including maintaining camera presence during meetings to support effective communication and team alignment
 
 
 Preferred Skills 
 Experience supporting, maintaining, troubleshooting, and enhancing existing enterprise applications, including ASP.NET/C#, Classic ASP, JavaScript, and SQL-based applications.

 Experience supporting applications across Windows and Linux/Unix environments, including troubleshooting application servers, integration, and environmental issues.

 Working knowledge of Visual Studio and related development, debugging, and troubleshooting tools.

 Experience with SQL databases, including troubleshooting application/database issues and working with established database standards.

 Working knowledge of FTP/SFTP and file-based integrations, including formats such as PostScript, AFP, PDF, and HTML.

 Experience performing and supporting applications, platforms, servers, and infrastructure-related upgrades, including testing, troubleshooting, implementation, and post-upgrade support.

 Demonstrated ability and willingness to learn, support, and administer technologies and enterprise platforms outside of their primary development expertise as business needs evolve.

 Ability to troubleshoot issues across applications, platforms, integration, server, and vendor layers, coordinating with internal teams and external vendors as needed.

 Comfortable working in an environment that includes a combination of legacy applications, established enterprise platforms, and evolving technologies.

 Strong customer-service orientation with the ability to build effective working relationships with business partners, technical teams, and vendors.

 Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical issues and solutions professionally.

 Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and take ownership of issues through resolution.

 Ability to develop practical, business-oriented solutions while balancing technical requirements, operational needs, supportability, and risk.

 Languages 
 .NET framework C#, Classic ASP, SQL, JavaScript, HTML, PowerShell, REST, etc.
 
Tools and other Apps to know about 
 Visual Studio IDE, Database Connection (SQL server and ODBC/DB2), ServiceNow, SharePoint, Postman, Office 365, Telerik, Kendo, etc.

 Databases 
 Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, DB2

 IDEs 
 Visual Studio Professional, Notepad++ etc.

 Methodologies 
 Agile, Scrum, Test Driven Development (TDD), Behavior Driven Development (BDD)

 Operating Systems 
 Windows OS, Linux/Unix
